grammar.summary: 本课学习表「保密」的被动语态与 to such an extent that。

points.title: to such an extent that 程度从句
points.explanation: ...to such an extent that no one can understand. such...that 的变体：to such an extent + that 结果。

examples.en: Some processes are kept secret to such an extent.
examples.cn: 有些工艺保密到了这种程度。

points.title: 被动表制度性保密
points.explanation: details are not published / workers are not told 行业保密的被动叙事：动作执行者刻意隐去。

examples.en: No one is allowed to know the full picture.
examples.cn: 任何人都不得知晓全貌。
